subject.title: feat(ios): pair multiple gateways and switch between them without re-pairing

question: Should maintainers accept this PR as the iOS-first implementation path for the multi-gateway registry after repair, or hold it for a coordinated mobile design?
rationale: The feature direction affects mobile credential storage, TLS trust, device-auth cleanup, push routing, cached transcripts, and eventual Android parity, and the linked issue is already marked for maintainer, product, and security review.

options.title: Repair And Review iOS Slice
options.body: Restore the regressed session controls, rebase on current main, then review the iOS registry as the first platform slice with explicit security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Hold For Coordinated Mobile Design
options.body: Pause this PR until iOS and Android registry semantics, credential migration, and device integrations are specified together.

options.title: Pause This Branch Behind The Issue
options.body: Keep the canonical issue as the product tracker and close or defer this branch if the repaired iOS slice is not the desired landing path.

recommendation.title: Repair And Review iOS Slice
recommendation.body: Restore the regressed session controls, rebase on current main, then review the iOS registry as the first platform slice with explicit security and upgrade proof.
